//: Default F5 / `dotnet run` profile for the scaffolded Reactor app. The --devtools
argument pairs with the Debug-only `Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Devtools` package +
Reactor.DevtoolsSupport host config option (see Company.ReactorApp1.csproj) so the
right-click devtools menu is available in Debug. Release builds (`dotnet run -c Release`)
ignore this file's args by default, and the devtools package is excluded from the build
graph in Release — passing --devtools to a Release exe prints a 'devtools requested but
this binary was built without Reactor.DevtoolsSupport' notice and continues with devtools
off. The Reactor Visual Studio embedded-preview extension (spec 056) launches with its
own argv (`--devtools run --embed --embed-host-pid <pid>`) and does not consult this file.
